display_name: Report a session's own context-window occupancy snapshot
description: Overwrites the caller's single latest runtime-neutral context snapshot. Required identity is agent_instance_id plus the runtime's native runtime_session_id, provider, runtime, model, and effort. current_tokens is the model-visible input count reported for the most recent assistant call; ceiling is the live runtime's effective context capacity for that call, not the provider API maximum. The caller already measured the local transcript, so this verb performs only a StateManagementInterface upsert and never reads a transcript or spawns a process. Optional cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens carry native counters from the same call. Optional cache_cold and cache_overage_signature remain tri-state: omission means NOT REPORTED, never warm; one zero cache read is not by itself proof of expiry or overage. measured_at is the reporter clock and reading_at is the native transcript-row clock. reporter_surface and reporter_generation attribute concurrent installed/source copies, while agent_session_id preserves the stable routing join. One row per agent_instance_id is overwritten as latest; the separate bounded history retains the series.
embedding_description: A Codex or Claude runtime reporting its own native session identity, provider, model, effort, current model-visible input tokens, live effective context ceiling, cache counters, clocks, and reporter attribution. Cache classifications are optional and never inferred from an unmeasured or single-call signal.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: {"status": "recorded"} on success — the caller's latest snapshot row was overwritten.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Routine and high-frequency (every un-throttled hook tick); do not narrate a normal success, only surface a failure.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: A predicated upsert on session_context_status, conflicting on agent_instance_id alone (one row per session, always latest).
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_argument: one of agent_instance_id/runtime_session_id/provider/runtime/model/effort/measured_at was empty. negative_tokens: current_tokens or an optional cache count was negative, or ceiling was not positive; this is a caller bug, not a transient fault. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound. unknown_reporter_surface: reporter_surface was not one of checkout/plugin_cache/vendored/release/unknown, so the write was refused before attribution could be poisoned.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: missing_argument and negative_tokens indicate the reporting hook computed or forwarded a bad value — fix the caller, do not retry the same call. state_service_unavailable is worth a retry once the platform is up. unknown_reporter_surface is likewise a caller bug: send 'unknown' when the hook cannot classify its own location — an admitted unknown is correct, an invented surface is not.
